GET /v1/credential-offers.description: List credential offers for your tenant. The response is a bare JSON array, so each documented field describes one offer object in that array. Use it to track pending and claimed OpenID4VCI (OpenID for Verifiable Credential Issuance) offers.

200.description: A bare JSON array of credential offer objects.

claimed_at.description: You receive the timestamp when the holder claimed the offer. You receive null while the offer is still pending.

claimed_by.description: You receive the holder identifier that claimed the offer. You receive an empty string until a holder claims it.

created_at.description: You receive the timestamp when Didit created the offer.

email_sent_at.description: You receive the timestamp when Didit sent the claim email. You receive null when no email has been sent.

expires_at.description: You receive the timestamp when the offer expires.

offer_id.description: Use this UUID to fetch, accept, or resend the credential offer.

recipient_email.description: You receive the email address associated with the offer. You receive an empty string when the offer has no email recipient.

schema_name.description: You receive the credential schema display name used by this offer.

status.description: You receive the current offer status.

tx_code_required.description: You receive true when the holder must enter a transaction code before issuance.

vct.description: You receive the VCT (Verifiable Credential Type) that this offer issues.

POST /v1/credential-offers.description: Create an OpenID4VCI (OpenID for Verifiable Credential Issuance) credential offer from one of your templates. You provide captured claim values, and Didit returns the claim URL, the wallet deep link, and the pre-authorized grant data. Send the returned transaction code to the holder through your own channel when the offer requires one.

claims.description: Send claim values keyed by the schema attribute name. This captured request includes `given_name` and `tier`.

given_name.description: Send the holder's given name when your template includes this claim.

tier.description: Send the membership tier when your template includes this claim.

template_id.description: Send the UUID of the credential template you want to issue from.

201.description: Didit created the credential offer and returned the claim links and grant data.

claim_url.description: Send this web claim URL to the holder when you use Didit's hosted claim flow.

credential_issuer.description: Use this issuer identifier as the OpenID4VCI (OpenID for Verifiable Credential Issuance) credential issuer.

credential_offer_uri.description: Encode this OpenID4VCI (OpenID for Verifiable Credential Issuance) credential-offer URI as a QR code or wallet deep link.

email_sent.description: You receive true when Didit sent the claim email during offer creation.

expires_at.description: You receive the timestamp when this offer expires.

grants.description: Pass this OpenID4VCI (OpenID for Verifiable Credential Issuance) grants object to the wallet. It contains the pre-authorized code grant.

urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:pre-aut.description: Use this grant object when the wallet exchanges the pre-authorized code for an issuance access token.

pre-authorized_code.description: Send this code to the token endpoint as `pre-authorized_code`.

offer_id.description: Use this UUID to fetch, accept, or resend the credential offer.

pre_authorized_code.description: You receive the pre-authorized code as a top-level convenience field.

recipient_email.description: You receive the email recipient configured for the offer. You receive an empty string when no recipient email was set.

tx_code.description: Send this transaction code to the holder through an out-of-band channel.

GET /v1/credential-offers/resolve.description: Resolve an OpenID4VCI (OpenID for Verifiable Credential Issuance) credential offer by tenant and pre-authorized code. Use this endpoint to render a wallet claim screen before the holder exchanges the code. The response shows labels only for claims in this captured flow.

params.name: code
params.description: Send the pre-authorized code from the credential offer URI.

params.name: tenant
params.description: Send the tenant slug that issued the offer.

200.description: Didit resolved the offer for the wallet claim screen.

claims.description: You receive the claims the wallet can show before issuance.

label.description: Show this human-readable claim label to the holder.

name.description: Use this machine-readable claim name to identify the attribute.

selective_disclosure.description: You receive true when the holder can selectively disclose this claim later.

expires_at.description: You receive the timestamp when the offer expires.

format.description: You receive the SD-JWT VC (Selective-Disclosure JWT Verifiable Credential) format value for this offer.

issuer.description: Use this issuer identity block to render the claim screen.

did.description: Show this decentralized identifier for the issuer.

domain.description: Use this issuer URL as the credential issuer identifier.

id.description: Use this tenant slug to identify the issuer.

name.description: Show this issuer display name to the holder.

offer_id.description: Use this UUID to identify the resolved credential offer.

offer_uri.description: Open this OpenID4VCI (OpenID for Verifiable Credential Issuance) credential-offer URI in a compatible wallet.

tx_code_length.description: Render a transaction-code input with this many digits.

tx_code_required.description: You receive true when the holder must enter a transaction code.

vct.description: You receive the VCT (Verifiable Credential Type) that this offer issues.

Use it to show the issuer, credential type, expiration, transaction-code requirement, and claim labels. This captured flow returns labels without claim values.

name.description: Use this machine-readable claim name to identify the attribute.

domain.description: Use this issuer URL as the credential issuer identifier.

id.description: Use this tenant slug to identify the issuer.

name.description: Show this issuer display name to the holder.

GET /v1/credential-offers/{uuid}/offer.description: Fetch the OpenID4VCI (OpenID for Verifiable Credential Issuance) credential-offer-by-reference document. Wallets open the `credential_offer_uri`, fetch this document, and then exchange the pre-authorized code at the token endpoint. This response follows the standard credential offer shape.

200.description: Didit returned the OpenID4VCI credential-offer document.

credential_configuration_ids.description: Use these credential configuration IDs to select the offered VCT (Verifiable Credential Type).

items.description: A credential configuration ID from the issuer metadata.

credential_issuer.description: Use this issuer identifier to discover metadata and validate the proof audience.

grants.description: Use this grants object to drive the token request.

urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:pre-aut.description: Use this pre-authorized code grant when you request an issuance access token.

tx_code.description: Use this transaction-code metadata to render the holder input.

description.description: Show this transaction-code instruction to the holder.

input_mode.description: Use this value to choose the holder input mode.

length.description: Render a transaction-code input with this many digits.

POST /v1/credential-offers/{uuid}/accept.description: Accept a credential offer through Didit's server-side demo shortcut. Didit redeems the OpenID4VCI (OpenID for Verifiable Credential Issuance) offer, creates a holder key, and returns the issued SD-JWT VC (Selective-Disclosure JWT Verifiable Credential). Use this only for demo flows where the server accepts the offer for the holder.

200.description: Didit accepted the offer and minted the credential.

credential.description: You receive the issued credential expanded for the holder UI.

claims.description: You receive the claims embedded in the issued credential.

label.description: Show this claim label to the holder.

name.description: Use this machine-readable claim name to identify the attribute.

selective_disclosure.description: You receive true when the holder can selectively disclose this claim later.

value.description: You receive the claim value included in the credential.

credential_name.description: Show this credential display name to the holder.

expires_at.description: You receive the credential expiration timestamp.

format.description: You receive the credential format value.

id.description: Use this identifier for the issued credential record.

issued_at.description: You receive the credential issuance timestamp.

issuer.description: Use this issuer identity block to render the credential.

did.description: Show this decentralized identifier for the issuer.

domain.description: Use this issuer domain as the credential issuer identifier.

id.description: Use this tenant identifier for the issuer.

name.description: Show this issuer display name to the holder.

sd_jwt.description: Store this SD-JWT VC (Selective-Disclosure JWT Verifiable Credential) string in the holder wallet.

status.description: You receive the issued credential status.

subject.description: Show this credential subject value to the holder.

vct.description: You receive the credential VCT (Verifiable Credential Type).

holder_jwk.description: You receive the public JWK (JSON Web Key) that Didit generated for this demo holder flow.

crv.description: You receive the elliptic curve name for the holder key.

kty.description: You receive the JWK (JSON Web Key) key type.

x.description: You receive the x-coordinate of the public key.

y.description: You receive the y-coordinate of the public key.

vct.description: You receive the VCT (Verifiable Credential Type) as a top-level convenience field.

POST /v1/credential-offers/{uuid}/resend.description: Resend the claim email for a pending credential offer. Use this when the offer has a recipient email and the holder needs a fresh delivery. The response returns the updated delivery state.

200.description: Didit resent the claim email and returned the offer delivery state.

claim_url.description: Send this web claim URL to the holder when you use Didit's hosted claim flow.

email_send_count.description: You receive the number of claim emails Didit has sent for this offer.

email_sent.description: You receive true when Didit sent the claim email.

expires_at.description: You receive the updated timestamp when the offer expires.

offer_id.description: Use this UUID to identify the credential offer.

recipient_email.description: You receive the email address that Didit sent the claim link to.

POST /v1/oauth/token.description: Exchange an OpenID4VCI (OpenID for Verifiable Credential Issuance) pre-authorized code for an issuance access token. Send the transaction code when the offer requires one. Use the returned token at the credential endpoint.

grant_type.description: Send the pre-authorized code grant type.

pre-authorized_code.description: Send the pre-authorized code from the credential offer.

tx_code.description: Send the transaction code when the credential offer requires one.

200.description: Didit issued a short-lived access token for credential issuance.

access_token.description: Send this token as the bearer token when you call the credential endpoint.

expires_in.description: You receive the access-token lifetime in seconds.

token_type.description: You receive the token type for the access token.

POST /v1/nonce.description: Mint a nonce for the OpenID4VCI (OpenID for Verifiable Credential Issuance) holder proof. Use the returned `c_nonce` inside the proof you send to the credential endpoint. The capture shows a 60-second nonce lifetime.

200.description: Didit minted a single-use challenge nonce.

c_nonce.description: Put this challenge nonce in the holder proof.

c_nonce_expires_in.description: You receive the nonce lifetime in seconds.

POST /v1/credential.description: Redeem an issuance access token and holder proof for an SD-JWT VC (Selective-Disclosure JWT Verifiable Credential). Send the proof generated by the holder wallet after you mint a nonce. Didit returns the issued credential and its VCT (Verifiable Credential Type).

proof.description: Send the holder proof object that binds issuance to the holder key.

jwt.description: Send the holder proof JWT (JSON Web Token). The captured value is redacted.

proof_type.description: Send the proof type advertised by the issuer metadata.

credential.description: Store this issued SD-JWT VC (Selective-Disclosure JWT Verifiable Credential) string in the holder wallet.

credentials.description: You receive the issued credentials array for wallet-compatible clients.

credential.description: Store this issued credential string in the holder wallet.

vct.description: You receive the VCT (Verifiable Credential Type) of the issued credential.

401.description: Didit rejected the issuance access token.

error.description: You receive the error code for the failed credential request.

error_description.description: You receive the reason Didit rejected the access token.

The metadata also lists credential configurations keyed by VCT (Verifiable Credential Type).
